what_it_does: Presents a 22-nanometer chip accelerator optimized for diffusion models (generative AI models used for image/video synthesis). Uses compute-in-memory (CIM)—performing calculations directly where data lives—to reduce data movement overhead. The accelerator handles the challenge that different layers need different amounts of bandwidth: memory is partitioned dynamically to match each layer's requirements. Includes specialized circuits for 3D and temporal (multi-frame) attention operations, achieving 60.81 trillion floating-point operations per watt of energy efficiency.
